text: Well, everybody knows that reading books or studying courses can shape people's identities and cultures.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: I think listening to music works the same way.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Music is not only about the rhythms — there are lyrics too, and singers are expressing themselves, expressing their thoughts through the lyrics.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: So if you listen to more music, more types of music, you get exposed to more styles that people live by, more ways that people think.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: And that shapes your identity and culture.
